reasoning_content: The pkill command is matching my own shell because the process command line contains "wave2.sh". I need to use a bracket pattern like 'wave2[.]sh' to exclude the literal string from the match.

action.command: pkill -f 'wave2[.]sh'; sleep 1; ps aux | grep -c 'wave2[.]sh' || echo "no wave2 running"
